sloka: ऋक्षवानररक्षांसि जनाश्च पुरवासिनः ।आगच्छन्परया भक्त्या पृष्ठतः सुसमाहिताः ।। ७.१०९.१९ ॥
transliteration: ṛkṣavānararakṣāṁsi janāśca puravāsinaḥ ।āgacchanparayā bhaktyā pṛṣṭhataḥ susamāhitāḥ ।। 7.109.19 ॥

translations.english: Bears, monkeys, rakshasas, and the city-dwellers, all well-composed, followed him from behind with supreme devotion.
